walkthroughs.body_html:
Practical Skills — a core area of A-Level Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Practical Skills brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Practical Skills.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which apparatus most accurately measures 25.0 cm³ for titration?
options: Beaker
Measuring cylinder
Pipette
Conical flask

mcqs.q: The end point of a strong acid-strong base titration is best detected by:
options: Methyl orange or phenolphthalein
Universal indicator
Silver nitrate
Limewater

mcqs.q: What does a mole of a substance represent?
options: A mole is a unit of mass equal to the relative molecular mass in grams of any substance.
Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
Avogadro's number (6.02 x 10^23) of particles of that substance.
A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.

mcqs.q: At room temperature and pressure, what volume does 1 mole of any gas occupy?
options: A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
Heavier gases occupy a smaller volume per mole because their particles are denser.
Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
Approximately 24 dm^3 (24,000 cm^3), regardless of the identity of the gas.

mcqs.q: If 50 cm^3 of a 1 mol/dm^3 solution is diluted to 100 cm^3, what is the new concentration?
options: The new concentration is 0.05 mol/dm^3 because you doubled the volume so you halve the concentration once and shift the decimal too.
The new concentration is 2 mol/dm^3 because adding water makes the solution stronger.
A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
0.5 mol/dm^3 — the moles stay the same but the volume doubled.
